title: mentha longifolia subsp. royleana
intro: Mentha longifolia subsp. royleana, commonly known as Indian pennyroyal, is a subspecies of mint native to the Himalayas and surrounding regions. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Indian pennyroyal include acting as a carminative, antispasmodic, and diuretic, making it useful for relieving flatulence, cramps, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of Mentha longifolia subsp. royleana include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
